archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: every step: the scorecard of one KIT_V5 run (its guards A1-A17), run before handing a run over
question: Does my run follow the kit rules (registers, claims, sealed files, budget, sourced decisions, pickup, disk, board, cleaning)?

commands.name: audit
commands.does: prints the run's scorecard (A1-A17, each PASS, WARN or FAIL), COUNTS and SCORE; with --write also writes RUN/audit/AUDIT_<stamp>.txt

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

refuses.when: USAGE ... or REFUSED: ... or NO RUN FOLDER ...: bad usage, no --settings, a settings file the reader refuses (RESEARCH_ROOT and BOARD must be set), no run folder. A run with FAIL checks still exits 0: read the SCORE line

rules: reads registers, receipts, the run's files and its board; writes only RUN/audit/AUDIT_<stamp>.txt with --write
A6 computes each decision again with decide_v2.py and decide_forward_v2.py from the same release folder
the exit code is 0 whatever the checks say: read the SCORE line

outputs.where: printed, and RUN/audit/AUDIT_<stamp>.txt with --write: one line per check A1-A17, then its failures or warnings
printed, and RUN/audit/AUDIT_<stamp>.txt with --write: the last line

dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; run AD1_20261029, idea FLOWX
